name: Node.js
description: Installs the Node.js runtime with npm and npx on a selectable channel.

version.description: Channel (lts|latest), a major line (24 or 24.19), or an exact version (major.minor.patch).

stateDir.description: If set, exports npm's cache, global prefix, and user config to this path (persist them by mounting a volume there). Empty puts the global prefix in the dev user's ~/.local.

npmrc.description: npm config as INI with \n line breaks, written to npm's user config file.
